task: Five fictional latent profiles plus an unknown output; NOT MaE 55-way classification
stages: Jev diagnoses and independently selects one fixed-bank probe from initial answer
Look up pre-authored answer to selected probe
Jev re-diagnoses from initial and probe answer; prior prediction hidden
probePolicy: Jev choice from the same three probes; no ground truth access; every initially incorrect scenario receives exactly one probe
baseline: Same selected probe: wrong => probe skill, correct => slip. No API call, no access to hidden profile. Cannot output mixed.
requestCache: Exact request JSON shared across scenarios is called once and referenced by SHA256. Before prediction shared across all noise regimes. No independent-replicate claim.
metrics: stratification by response regime and initial error mode
errorPolicy: Stop on first transport/API/schema failure, preserve logs; no retry or replacement predictions
tuning: Dataset, response table, prompts and policy frozen before API calls. No result-driven tuning in this run.
limitations: Author-defined error procedures and balanced priors are not observed student distributions
Noise regimes are stress tests, not calibrated probabilities
One response does not uniquely identify all hidden profiles
Simple baseline assumes error maps to tested skill
No teacher review or evidence about real students, curriculum coverage or learning outcomes
Descriptive aggregate gives equal weight to regimes; no independent-sample significance claim
